summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing routine daily repurchase disclosures to the ASX under its existing $1 billion stock buyback program. The program authorizes the company to acquire Class A and B common stock from time to time, but this filing only provides routine transaction reports; no specific price, premium, or timing is given. The board continues to support the program, with no advisors named. The repurchase is an open-market, at-the-market program subject to market conditions and securities laws. What to watch: pace of buybacks and any changes in authorization.
